run_COLMAP_pipeline: run the COLMAP pipeline to extract features, match, and reconstruct sparse 3D structure from images
run_feature_extractor: run COLMAP feature extraction on an image directory and store results in a database
run_exhaustive_matcher: run COLMAP exhaustive feature matching across all images in the database
run_mapper: run COLMAP mapper to reconstruct sparse 3D structure from matched features
gen_poses: generate camera poses and bounds from COLMAP output and save as poses_bounds.npy
